one-drop-a-second.sentence: A rate or a count asked for in words is not held either. "One single drop falling into water every second" came back with 40 to 69 onsets in 26 s over four seeds. Generate one event and place it at the rate yourself (§ Recipes).
one-drop-a-second.claim: Asked in words for one drop a second, the model does not keep the rate: more onsets than were asked, bunched in bursts. Asked for a single drop, it gives one that the hand can cut and place on a one-second grid, so the rate is kept by the hand, exactly by construction. (On the page: this sentence, 'place it at the rate yourself', and the recipe it points to.)
chain: Stable Audio Open (small-sfx): the drip as asked in words, seed 1935, 26 s; one drop alone over seeds 1932-1935, 4 s
hand (Sound from Code): cut one drop by third.py's rule, place it once a second, join the halves, measure on the saved file
Drawn SVG: two lanes from the same arrays, onsets by the page's own detector
